name: Application service health snapshot
intent: One snapshot: service status, open P1/P2, open alerts, next change.

service.description: Application service name (resolved constrained to service classes)

procedure: Resolve the service via sn.cmdb.ci.find constrained to service classes.
Summarize related open incidents and alerts. Do not list every member CI unless asked.

prompts: How healthy is the payroll application service?
Is the ERP service up and what is open on it?
